mapper.sql: id, member_id, order_sn, application_type, product_name, product_attr, reason, description, status, status_note, fulfillment_status, fulfillment_note, create_time, update_time, reviewed_by, reviewed_at
mapper.select: select from ai_after_sales_application where id = #{id} limit 1
mapper.update: update ai_after_sales_application set status = #{status}, status_note = #{statusNote}, fulfillment_status = #{fulfillmentStatus}, fulfillment_note = #{fulfillmentNote}, fulfillment_updated_at = case when #{status} = 'ACCEPTED' then now() else fulfillment_updated_at end, open_scope_key = null, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING_REVIEW'
mapper.insert: insert into ai_after_sales_outbox ( event_id, application_id, member_id, application_source, event_type, status, attempt_count, available_at, lease_until, published_at, last_error, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{eventId}, #{applicationId}, #{memberId}, #{applicationSource}, #{eventType}, 'PENDING', 0, null, null, null, null, now(), now() )
